data.narrative:
Xage Security is a Series B defense and security company that has raised $80M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 firms—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $80M total raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implies a valuation of $152M. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The dispersion within the peer set reflects variability in business maturity, revenue traction, and market positioning across defense-tech ventures at this stage.

The two methods produce a meaningful spread. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $638M. The gap between stage-progression ($152M) and peer-median ($1.1B) reflects uncertainty around whether Xage's market penetration and defensibility align with the higher-valued cohort or whether a discount to peer median is warranted. Key uncertainties include revenue run rate, customer concentration, and the sustainability of demand within constrained government procurement cycles.
